research_question: Can an LLM-free learner predict complete operator sequences for heldout connected DAG motifs from training-only topology statistics, rather than binding operator holes from the heldout answer?

split.formula: integer value of sha256(salt || graph_id) modulo 5

motif_universe.enumeration: all connected induced DAG subsets of eligible tensor call_function nodes
motif_universe.topology: exact node count, internal edges, external input uses, and output indices
motif_universe.target_sequence: ordered exact ATen target string at every motif node

candidate.eligible_topology: at least three training occurrences spanning at least two training families
candidate.prediction: most frequent complete target sequence for that exact topology
candidate.abstain: every heldout motif whose topology is ineligible

controls.boundary_frequency: on the identical eligible heldout motif rows, predict the most frequent training target sequence grouped only by node count and output indices
controls.global_size_frequency: on the identical eligible heldout motif rows, predict the most frequent training target sequence grouped only by node count
controls.supplied_fixed_portfolio: report whether the heldout exact target sequence occurs in ATEN_FIXED_PORTFOLIO_V2
controls.topology_oracle_upper_bound: count every eligible heldout motif without operator prediction

primary_endpoints.eligible_heldout_motifs: heldout motifs whose topology satisfies the frozen training threshold
primary_endpoints.candidate_exact_sequences: eligible motifs whose complete operator sequence equals the training-only topology prediction
primary_endpoints.boundary_exact_sequences: the same rows exactly predicted by the boundary-frequency control
primary_endpoints.global_exact_sequences: the same rows exactly predicted by the size-frequency control
primary_endpoints.paired_candidate_wins: rows candidate predicts exactly and boundary control misses
primary_endpoints.paired_boundary_wins: rows boundary control predicts exactly and candidate misses
primary_endpoints.candidate_exact_families: distinct heldout families with an exact candidate prediction
primary_endpoints.candidate_exact_folds: distinct folds with an exact candidate prediction
primary_endpoints.unseen_sequences_predicted: must be zero because a frequency learner cannot emit an unseen sequence

decision_rule.operator_prediction_positive: at least ten eligible heldout motifs, candidate exact predictions in at least three families and three folds, paired candidate wins exceed paired boundary wins, candidate exact count exceeds both controls, and both implementations plus hostile/resource gates pass
decision_rule.valid_negative: complete execution passes but the candidate does not satisfy every positive condition
decision_rule.infrastructure_failure: implementations disagree, any fold leaks heldout targets, graph assignment changes, hostile checks fail, or resource limits fail
